design: Post-hoc diagnostic after observing lookup discrepancies in the recent links. All features, fitting and the residual guard use only the 36 older archives. The 24 recent links are rescored unchanged and are not a prospective trial of a new selector.
fit_note: One nonnegative no-intercept linear model per resolver plus one nonnegative other bytes/selection. Each target uses 1/max(4096, |measured bytes|) weighted residual, column RMS normalization and ridge 0.001. Body uses old symbol spans/structural median without multiplicative lookup adjustment.
feature_note: Sequence nonfirst edges are unique prefix trie edges beyond the first instruction.

old_cross_validation.method: withhold whole previous search method and purge identical table from training, including its symbols
